<subject>Re: Our Luncheon</subject>
<body>
Suzanne,

Michael is with the Global Contracts Team. Could you please coordinate with him on the exact head count as the date approaches? Thank you!

----- Forwarded by Lisa Martin/NY/CP on 06/10/2024 08:15 AM -----

	Michael Reynolds
	06/10/2024 06:40 AM
		
		 To: Lisa Martin/NY/CP@CP
		 cc: 
		 Subject: Re: Our Luncheon

Lisa,

The date works well for everyone who has responded so far. I am still waiting to hear back from the remaining invitees. I will update you on the final head count as soon as I receive all responses.

Apologies for the delay,  
Michael

From: Lisa Martin on 06/09/2024 08:50 AM  
To: Michael Reynolds/NY/CP@CP  
cc: Sarah Collins/NY/CP@CP, Emily Foster/NY/CP@CP  
Subject: Our Luncheon

Michael,

I haven’t heard back from you regarding whether the proposed date is suitable and the total number of attendees. Could you please confirm at your earliest convenience? Thanks.

----- Forwarded by Lisa Martin/NY/CP on 06/09/2024 08:49 AM -----

	Lisa Martin  
	05/25/2024 05:00 PM  
		 
		 To: Michael Reynolds/NY/CP@CP  
		 cc:  
		 Subject: Our Luncheon

Emily Foster had her assistant reserve Conference Room B on June 20 from 11:30 AM to 2:00 PM for our luncheon. Could you please confirm if this date works for your team and provide the total head count? Suzanne will handle lunch arrangements.

Thanks so much!  
</body>
